headline: A 2014 law renamed a VA outpatient clinic in Mankato, Minnesota, after a man named Lyle C. Pearson.
what_it_does: The law gives the Department of Veterans Affairs clinic at 1961 Premier Drive in Mankato, Minnesota, a new official name: the Lyle C. Pearson Community Based Outpatient Clinic. It is a naming measure only. It does not change the clinic's services, staffing, or funding.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 16, 2014, and the renaming took effect on that date.
